        if (c == '-') sign = -1;
        c = getchar();
    }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getchar();
    }
    return x * sign;
}

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

ll modInverse(ll a) {
    return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
}

void addMod(int& a, int b) {
    a = (a + b) % MOD;
    if (a < 0) a += MOD;
}

void subMod(int& a, int b) {
    a = (a - b + MOD) % MOD;
}

    int n = a.size();
